name: @tss-pricing/api6-client
description: Single door to API6. Raw facts only (routing, cost candidates + provenance, elements, FX, BI history). One call per pricing run. Dev mode replays ./recorded payloads. Pluggable outbound auth: NoAuth, API key, Basic, OAuth2 client-credentials, and a BTP-destination meta-strategy that delegates to whichever of those a resolved destination declares.
